title: Homomorphisms into a finite reflexive module over a Noetherian domain are reflexive
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the module of homomorphisms from an arbitrary finite module into a finite reflexive module over a Noetherian domain is again reflexive, and the proof is an 8-line argument through a presentation. It chooses a presentation of the source module, dualises it into a short exact sequence whose middle term is a finite sum of copies of the reflexive module, observes that the quotient term is torsion free as a submodule of such a sum, and then invokes the sequence criterion of the same section which says that a module sitting in a sequence with reflexive middle term and torsion free quotient is reflexive. The two steps — the dualised sequence and the identification of the criterion — are both displayed.
